releases.name: v1.54.0
releases.notes:
### Added Features

- report the perl interpreter as a cpan package [PR [#5132](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5132) @wagoodman]
- Add package cataloger for perl ecosystem [Issue [#1906](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/1906)] [PR [#5131](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5131) @wagoodman]
- Analyze with Non-Daemon podman [Issue [#1173](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/1173)]

### Bug Fixes

- write a name for the root package when the source has none [PR [#5349](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5349) @DrVelvetFog]
- match opensource.org license URLs across SPDX URL forms [PR [#5361](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5361) @willmurphyscode]
- Account for malformed GGUF and safetensors parameter counts [PR [#5343](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5343) @wagoodman]
- don't panic on a root file without a supplier or null entries [PR [#5326](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5326) @DrVelvetFog]
- do not panic on a stack.yaml rev pin [PR [#5310](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5310) @arpitjain099]
- report scanner errors and raise the line cap in metadata parsers [PR [#5353](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5353) @wagoodman]
- Harden cataloger parsers against truncated input (do not panic) [PR [#5355](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5355) @wagoodman]
- bound CPE candidate generation for pathological package metadata [PR [#5356](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5356) @wagoodman]
- account for UPX's loader padding when unpacking Go binaries [PR [#5347](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5347) @huuyafwww]
- handle malformed GGUF headers without panicking [PR [#5345](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5345) @wagoodman]
- bound model companion file reads and validate their contents [PR [#5344](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5344) @wagoodman]
- don't fail the whole SBOM when a cataloger panics on one file [PR [#5342](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5342) @wagoodman]
- release package collection lock in Ubuntu ESM detection [PR [#5336](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5336) @sverrirsig]
- render TUI log lines on their own rows, with colors and a small header [PR [#5324](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5324) @wagoodman]
- uv.lock: dependents are linked to every locked version of a dependency [Issue [#5340](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5340)] [PR [#5351](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5351) @devtechedge]
- java-archive-cataloger maps Apache Groovy 4+ (org.apache.groovy) to obsolete org.codehaus.groovy [Issue [#5311](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5311)] [PR [#5313](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5313) @texasich]
- Support traefik binary various versions [Issue [#4980](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4980)] [PR [#5281](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5281) @mayanksekhar]
- File Digests Remain at Zero, No Hashes Available Despite .syft.yaml Settings Should Support [Issue [#5325](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5325)] [PR [#5341](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5341) @wagoodman]
- not showing expat CVEs from syft generated sbom [Issue [#4771](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4771)] [PR [#5259](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5259) @KR-Ravindra]
- PHP extensions are cataloged as upstream products using the PHP version [Issue [#5014](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5014)] [PR [#5102](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5102) @pujitha24]
- Panic during scanning with gguf-cataloger/safetensors-cataloger [Issue [#5327](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5327)] [PR [#5328](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5328) @tk1475]
- github-actions cataloger emits an invalid PURL for docker:// use statements [Issue [#5299](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5299)] [PR [#5302](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5302) @yunaremaia]
- Crash when running syft on a directory that is the root file system of a Yocto build [Issue [#5320](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5320)] [PR [#5321](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5321) @somaz94]
- Invalid PURLs when cataloging instrumentation classes/jars [Issue [#2596](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/2596)]
